Indian Railways Reports 6.14% Freight Loading Growth in September

Indian Railways reported a 6.14% increase in freight loading for September, reaching 135.5 million tonnes. Freight revenue for the month also saw a 9.3% growth, amounting to ₹1,266 crore more than the previous year. The data compares September 2026 with September 2025.
